europe_now.title: Unrest and Political Pressure in France
europe_now.summary: France faces widespread civil unrest and looting following a weekend of protests, leading to intense political pressure on the government. President Emmanuel Macron rejected the interior minister's resignation offer after officials admitted police lost control of the demonstrations.

top_stories.summary: France is grappling with widespread civil unrest and severe property damage following a weekend of protests. President Emmanuel Macron rejected the interior minister's resignation after authorities acknowledged that police had lost control of the situation.
